main_text.p: homines æqualiter dividimus: Nos pauperibus, quæ illis à divitibus debebantur, restituimus. quo obtentu, كاذوا يبخلون على الرجل فيقتلونه على اموالسه [?] i.e. quemlibet liberè invadentes, ipsô opum vel mulierum causâ vitam eriperent.

18 عمرو Amrus, Al Mondari filius, cognominatus مضرط الحجارة Modret ol'bajarah, ac si dicas Lapillos لشدة وصرامته scil. ob summam ejus audaciam, & robur invictum teste{*} Al Sauhario, dictus alias ابن هند Ebn Hend, à matre Hendâ. anno regni ejus octavo natus est Mohammedes.
19 قابوس Kabus, Amri frater: quem tamen volunt alii non regnâsse, sed quòd Regis & filius fuerit, & frater, eodem ipsum titulo insignitum.
20 المنذر Al Mondar, ipsius itidem frater.

21 النعمان Al Nooman, Al Mondari filius, qui ابو قابوس Abu Kabus cognominatus est: hic est (inquit Abul Feda) النصر الذي i.e. Qui Christo nomen dedit. Causâ ejus ad Christum conversionis hanc narrant Arabum{*} historiæ. Al Nooman isti amici, seu compotatores bini erant, quos aliquando ebrius vivos (vino tantum somnoq; sepultos) sepeliri jusserat. Facti autem, cùm à vino expergisceretur, pæni-tentiâ ductus, in veteris amicitiæ memoriam tumulum illis condidit, ac duos sibi dies statuit, quorum alterum يوم بوس i.e. Diem tristitiæ, alterum يوم فعيس Diem lætitiæ appellavit, hac lege in perpetuum observandos, ut si die qui tristitiæ dicatus fuerat, cuiquam profectus occurreret, fuso ipsius sanguine tumulum istum tingeret; si eo qui lætitiæ, muneribus onustum dimitteret. Die igitur tristitiæ cùm ei occurreret.

page.notes:
In ضرط (marginal note beside the line "ob summam ejus audaciam"; the Arabic word is doubtful, the marker reads "In" with the Arabic word after it). Al Midani, & Ahmed Ebn Yusef. (note beside the line "Arabum*"; "Midani" is set with a hyphen at the line end, read as printed.)

Arabic words in this transcription are copied as far as they can be read from the scan. Several lines of Arabic are uncertain, particularly the first line of the top paragraph, the word after "scil." and the words after "Abu Kabus"; they are not marked with [?] inside the Arabic itself, so check them against the original.
